extDescription.message: Organize the repositories of a GitHub organization into groups and subgroups, shared with the whole org.

signInHint.message: Sign in to see your organization's repositories in groups.

deviceHint.message: Enter this code on GitHub to finish signing in.

popupOrgsEmpty.message: None of your organizations has a repo-groups.yml yet.

optionsTokenIntro.message: Use a token instead of the GitHub App sign-in. It is stored in this browser and only the extension background reads it.

optionsTokenSaved.message: Token saved. You are signed in as $LOGIN$.

optionsTokenKinds.message: Use a classic token with the repo and read:org scopes, or a fine-grained token whose resource owner is the organization.

optionsTokenPolicy.message: Whether an organization accepts the token depends on its policy: fine-grained tokens may need owner approval, classic tokens may be blocked, and organizations with SAML SSO require you to authorize the token for SSO.

optionsCacheIntro.message: Repository lists and organization files are kept in this browser so pages open instantly. Clearing them does not sign you out or reset your settings.

optionsCacheCleared.message: Cache cleared. Data reloads on your next visit.

optionsIntervalHint.message: A visit inside this interval uses the cached data and makes no request to GitHub. The default is 5.

optionsOrgsSignedOut.message: Sign in to list your organizations.

optionsOrgsEmpty.message: No organizations found for this account.

optionsOrgGroupedHint.message: Applies when you have not picked a view for this organization. A GitHub filter in the URL still opens GitHub's own list.

optionsActionBody.message: Large organizations can let a GitHub Action write repo-index.json to the .github repository. It is off by default. An org file editor turns it on by setting index: action in repo-groups.yml; there is nothing to switch here.

optionsActionWarning.message: Everyone who can read <org>/.github can read the names and descriptions of all repositories in the file, including private ones they cannot open. Only enable it in organizations where members already see every repository.

optionsAiIntro.message: When the rules and the local score cannot place a new repository, an AI can suggest the group. It is optional and only runs on those cases.

optionsAiPrivacy.message: Only the repository name, its description and the list of group names and descriptions are sent to the provider. On free plans the provider may use what you send to improve its products.

optionsAiKeyHint.message: Paste only the key. The extension finds a Gemini model that is responding and keeps using it until it stops.

optionsAiKeySaved.message: A key is saved. Leave this empty to keep it.

optionsAiGetKey.message: Get a free key in Google AI Studio

optionsAiStatusPending.message: Key saved. The model is chosen on first use.

optionsAiDenied.message: The browser did not allow requests to the provider, so the key was not saved.

optionsAiAuto.message: Classify new repositories with the AI by default

optionsAiAutoHint.message: When no rule matches the name of a new repository, the AI runs on its own and files it in a group, or suggests a new one. Uncheck to run it only when you click AI. Each run sends the repository name to the provider.
